definitions.explanation: A large body of salt water. In Japanese, {海|うみ} is used for both 'sea' and 'ocean' in everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{海|うみ}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the sea during summer vacation.
I like swimming in the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{海|うみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: You can see the ocean from this room, so it feels great every day.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{塩|しお}からい→塩辛い：02522_shiokarai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{飲|の}まないで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渇|かわ}いたら→渇く：10965_kawaku⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ってきました→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧。
examples.english: Sea water is salty, so please don't drink it. If you're thirsty, I brought water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{海|うみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{泳|およ}いだり→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧、⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めたり→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧、⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ったり→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I went to the sea with my family every summer and swam, collected shells, and built sandcastles.

notes:
{海|うみ} is a fundamental nature word used for both "sea" and "ocean" in everyday Japanese.

SCOPE:
In English, "sea" and "ocean" have different meanings, but {海|うみ} covers both. For technical distinctions, ⟦{大洋|たいよう}→大洋：09679_taiyou⟧ means "ocean."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {海|うみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the sea/beach
- {海|うみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: to swim in the sea
- {海|うみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|さち}→幸：noentry⟧: seafood (lit. bounty of the sea)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: coast, beach
- ⟦{海水浴|かいすいよく}→海水浴：10972_kaisuiyoku⟧: sea bathing
- ⟦{日本海|にほんかい}→日本海：noentry⟧: Sea of Japan
- ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧: Pacific Ocean

CULTURAL NOTE:
{海|うみ} and ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain) together represent Japan's iconic landscapes. The phrase {海|うみ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (sea or mountains?) is a common question about vacation preferences.
